description: Convert a German PDF invoice into an e-invoice: XRechnung 3.0 (UBL and CII), a ZUGFeRD PDF (EN 16931) and a check report, checked against the KoSIT rules. Files are written next to the PDF. If mandatory data is missing, nothing is written and the result lists the missing fields with a German label, help text and example: ask the user for them (or use the offered escape value when it fits), then call again with the same PDF and `answers`. Wrong values read from the PDF are fixed with `corrections` (keys from found[].edit[].key, e.g. fix:number). Each converted invoice counts once against the monthly quota of the user's pdfvera plan; the same PDF again in the same month does not count, check_only never counts.

answers.description: Values for missing fields, keyed by questions[].field, e.g. {"buyer_reference": "04011000-12345-06"}

check_only.description: Only check, write no files and use no quota

corrections.description: Corrections of values read from the PDF, keyed by found[].edit[].key, e.g. {"fix:number": "RE-2026-0042"}

output_dir.description: Folder for the result files; default: the PDF's folder

pdf_path.description: Path of the PDF invoice on this computer

role.description: Whether the user issued (issuer) or received (recipient) the invoice; only changes the wording of the questions

name: convert_invoice
title: PDF invoice to XRechnung and ZUGFeRD
